name: Jiujie zhi Shang
source:
You play as Mo Sheng (莫生) — an ordinary disciple with only average talent in a sect known as the Xuan Sect (玄门). In the past, he was bullied and humiliated by his senior brother Xiao Tianyu (箫天羽).

Xiao Tianyu is everything Mo Sheng is not: the strongest young cultivator in the sect, a “chosen one” favored by fate itself.

Mo Sheng envies him… and hates him.

One day, by pure chance, Mo Sheng obtains a mysterious artifact — one that can steal “fortune” (气运) from others. In this setting, “fortune” is more than luck: it’s a combination of talent, destiny, opportunity, and the invisible advantages that make someone “born to win.”

With this power, Mo Sheng begins a dangerous plan: to take the women around Xiao Tianyu — one by one — and steal his fortune step by step… until nothing is left.

But Xiao Tianyu’s fortune is overwhelming. He is the top prodigy of the entire generation.

Can Mo Sheng truly succeed? Or will Xiao Tianyu discover the truth… and end him first?

[From [url=https://giantswordstudio.itch.io/above-immortality-realm]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演莫生——玄门门派中资质平庸的普通弟子。当年，他曾被师兄萧天羽欺凌羞辱。

萧天宇却是莫笙所没有的：宗门最强的年轻修士，被命运眷顾的“天选者”。

默笙羡慕他……又恨他。

有一天，默笙机缘巧合得到了一件神秘神器——可以偷别​​人“气运”的神器。在这种背景下，“财富”不仅仅是运气：它是天赋、命运、机会以及使人“生而为赢”的无形优势的结合。

凭借这种力量，默笙开始了一项危险的计划：将萧天宇身边的女人一一带走，一步步窃取他的财产……直到一无所有。

但萧天宇的身家却是压倒性的。他是整个一代的顶尖神童。

默笙真的能成功吗？还是萧天宇会发现真相……并先结束他？
